full_judgment: 5. Mr. Syed Jafor Sohel, the learned counsel for the respondent-Bank, on the other hand, by filing affidavit-in-opposition opposes the Rule. He has not argued anything addressing the sole argument pressed in to service by the learned counsel for the petitioner. However, relying on the decisions reported in 54 DLR 144, 4 BLT 80 and 1 BLC 179 he tried to impress upon this Division that in a given situation and under a particular facts and circumstances a revision against any interlocutory order by Artha Rin Adalat lies.
